title: AEOI - Tool gateway
description: Which tool is denied, failing or slow, and for which agent?

panels.title: Tool calls per hour, by status
panels.description: OK, DENIED (policy said no), ERROR, TIMEOUT, PENDING (the recorded intent of a consequential call).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, 1h), status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM tools.tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Denials by code, agent and tool
panels.description: denial_code is derived by the DB from the stored reason; the reason text is not readable here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT denial_code, coalesce(agent_name, '(user, no agent)') AS agent, tool_name, count(*) AS denials, max(created_at) AS last_seen FROM tools.tool_calls WHERE status = 'DENIED' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY denials DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Per tool: calls, outcomes, retries, latency

targets.rawSql: SELECT tool_name, count(*) AS calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'OK') AS ok, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DENIED') AS denied, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ERROR') AS error, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'TIMEOUT') AS timeout, count(*) FILTER (WHERE attempt > 1) AS retried, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) FILTER (WHERE status = 'OK') AS p95_ok_ms FROM tools.tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Consequential calls (need a recorded approval)
panels.description: The DB refuses an executed consequential call without an approval (constraint, ADR-007).

targets.rawSql: SELECT tool_name, status, count(*) AS calls, max(created_at) AS last_seen FROM tools.tool_calls WHERE side_effect = 'CONSEQUENTIAL' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
